visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extremely low-angle perspective looking up from the floor between two women. A woman in a black skirt stands above the camera, holding a brown patterned Louis Vuitton handbag, while another woman in a beige t-shirt and leopard-print pants looks down from below. They appear to be in a hallway with a white grid ceiling and a black security camera lens visible. (2) A transition occurs as a large pink rubber shoe sole steps directly over the camera lens, briefly filling the frame with a solid pink texture before cutting to the next scene. (3) The scene shifts to a brightly lit airport terminal. Two young women, one with her hair in a top bun and wearing a white t-shirt, and another with long dark hair in a purple top, smile and wave enthusiastically at the camera, making peace signs. A large illuminated sign in the background reads 'TAIWAN'. (4) A sequence of still photos and short clips shows the two women at Hong Kong Disneyland wearing Minnie Mouse ear headbands. They pose in front of rocky landscapes and green foliage, maintaining joyful expressions and making victory signs. (5) A group photo features the two women, a man, and a baby posing with a Pluto mascot in front of a Disney-themed building with climbing vines. The lighting is bright and natural. (6) Close-up photos conclude the video, showing the two women smiling while holding plush Disney toys (ShellieMay and Olu Mel) in a warm indoor retail environment.
